name: Kaimori Aoha
source: Aohs is second year student and student council secretary. Aoha seems to be a tsundere but she became attached to Akira once Aoha fall into love. Aoha is a hard worker. Aoha studies in the school, do work for student council, work in a cafe and do housework herself, bua Aoha conceals her efforts. No one notices her hard work, Aoha watch out for Akira because Akria is on the blacklist of student council, Aoha respects Tsukine because Tsukine is kind without calculation.
